fullTextEN: Hello.

fullTextZH: 你工作的地方会叫你化妆吗？
fullTextEN: Does your workplace require you to wear makeup?
I have worked in many places.

fullTextZH: 可是有3个地方叫我化妆。
fullTextEN: But there were three places that asked me to wear makeup.

fullTextZH: 第一个地方是我在北京教中文的时候。
fullTextEN: The first place was when I taught Chinese in Beijing.

fullTextZH: 我在一个教韩国人的学校工作。
fullTextEN: I worked at a school teaching Koreans.

fullTextZH: 我的学生大部分是韩国人。
fullTextEN: Most of my students were Korean.

fullTextZH: 大部分的学生，他们化妆。
fullTextEN: Most of the students wore makeup.
So my principal said,
all of us had to wear makeup.
I don't like wearing makeup.
I also didn't like that school.
So I didn't listen.
I didn't wear makeup.

fullTextZH: 第二个地方是我在悉尼的第一个工作。
fullTextEN: The second place was my first job in Sydney.
Three years ago when I came to Sydney,

fullTextZH: 我在一个日本饭店工作。
fullTextEN: I worked at a Japanese restaurant.

fullTextZH: 我知道大部分日本人工作的时候，
fullTextEN: I know that most Japanese people wear makeup at work,
so I wore makeup too.
for the interview.
My manager said,
You need to wear makeup at work.
I said I put on makeup, hmm.

fullTextZH: 他说，嗯，你这里这里要红一点儿。
fullTextEN: He said, hmm, you need a bit more red here and here.

fullTextZH: 所以我工作的时候，我常常化妆成这样。
fullTextEN: So when I work, I often do my makeup like this.

fullTextZH: 然后我的室友常常笑我，
fullTextEN: Then my roommate often laughs at me,

fullTextZH: 因为他觉得我化妆化的很可爱，
fullTextEN: because he thinks my makeup is very cute,
very strange.

fullTextZH: 那个时候我很喜欢在日本饭店工作，
fullTextEN: At that time, I really liked working at a Japanese restaurant,

fullTextZH: 因为我的同事非常非常好。
fullTextEN: because my colleagues were very, very nice.

fullTextZH: 虽然我的经理非常非常刻薄，
fullTextEN: Although my manager was very, very harsh,

fullTextZH: 可是我很想练习我的日语，
fullTextEN: I really wanted to practice my Japanese,
so I thought it was okay.
I can wear makeup.

fullTextZH: 第三个工作是我在悉尼的一个，
fullTextEN: The third job was one I had in Sydney,
working at a hotel.
One day a guest complained,

fullTextZH: 他说有一个服务员没有化妆。
fullTextEN: saying a waiter wasn't wearing makeup.

fullTextZH: 然后经理给我们写邮件，
fullTextEN: Then the manager emailed us,
saying we all need to wear makeup.
At that time, I thought, hmm, okay.
If the manager asks me to wear makeup,
Of course, I will wear makeup.
But I have a colleague,
I really like her.
She is my good friend.
She is an Argentinian,
She is a feminist.

fullTextZH: 她听到经理叫我们化妆，
fullTextEN: When she heard the manager ask us to wear makeup,
She said, hmm,

fullTextZH: 为什么我觉得经理性别歧视？
fullTextEN: Why do I feel the manager is sexist?

fullTextZH: 所以她决定她不要化妆。
fullTextEN: So she decided she wouldn't wear makeup.
So we,
All decided we wouldn't wear makeup.
Do you think,

fullTextZH: 我们的经理有没有炒我们的鱿鱼？
fullTextEN: Did our manager fire us?
No.

fullTextZH: 经理最喜欢我和我的好朋友，
fullTextEN: The manager likes me and my good friend the most,
So we didn't wear makeup.

fullTextZH: 我们继续在这个酒店工作。
fullTextEN: We continued working at this hotel.
What about you? When you are working,

fullTextZH: 有没有人叫你必须化妆？
fullTextEN: Is there anyone who tells you that you must wear makeup?

fullTextZH: 你觉得这个公平不公平？
fullTextEN: Do you think this is fair or unfair?
Please leave a message and tell me.
Thank you, goodbye.
